class UnionFind
  def initialize(size : Int32)
    @root = Array(Int32).new(size, -1)
  end

  def union(i, j)
    a = root(i)
    b = root(j)
    if a != b
      @root[a] += @root[b]
      @root[b] = a
    end
  end

  def find(i, j)
    root(i) == root(j)
  end

  def root(i)
    return i if @root[i] < 0
    @root[i] = root(@root[i])
  end
end

 forest <- newListArray (0,n-1) [0..n-1] :: IO (IOUArray Int Int)

makepath (forest,acc) ((a,b),d) = do
 rep1 <- untilFix (readArray forest) a
 rep2 <- untilFix (readArray forest) b
 if rep1 /= rep2
  then do
   writeArray forest rep2 rep1
   writeArray forest b rep1
   return (forest, acc+d)
  else do
   return (forest, acc)

type MUFTree s = VUM.MVector s Int
type UFTree = VU.Vector Int

initMUF :: Int -> ST s (MUFTree s)
{-# INLINE initMUF #-}
initMUF len = VUM.replicate len minBound

findUF :: MUFTree s -> Int -> ST s Int
{-# INLINE findUF #-}
findUF vec j = do
  vj <- VUM.read vec j
  if vj < 0 then
    return j
  else do
    root <- findUF vec vj
    VUM.write vec j root
    return root
 
unionUF :: MUFTree s -> Int -> Int -> ST s Bool
{-# INLINE unionUF #-}
unionUF vec i j = do
  rooti <- findUF vec i
  rootj <- findUF vec j
  if rooti == rootj then
    return False
  else do
    ranki <- VUM.read vec rooti
    rankj <- VUM.read vec rootj
    case compare ranki rankj of
      LT ->    VUM.write vec rootj rooti
      GT ->    VUM.write vec rooti rootj
      EQ -> do VUM.write vec rootj rooti
               VUM.write vec rooti (ranki+1)
    return True

radSortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
       => Int               -- ^ the number of passes
       -> Int               -- ^ the size of auxiliary arrays
       -> (Int -> e -> Int) -- ^ the radix function
       -> v (PrimState m) e -- ^ the array to be sorted
       -> m ()
radSortBy passes size rdx arr = do
  tmp    <- VGM.new (VGM.length arr)
  count  <- VPM.new size
  radSort_loop passes rdx arr tmp count
{-# INLINE radSortBy #-}



radSort_loop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
          => Int                          -- passes
          -> (Int -> e -> Int)            -- radix function
          -> v (PrimState m) e            -- array to sort
          -> v (PrimState m) e            -- temporary array
          -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -- radix count array
          -> m ()
radSort_loop passes rdx src dst count = go False 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go swap k
   | k < passes = if swap
                    then radSort_body (rdx k) dst src count >> go False (k+1)
                    else radSort_body (rdx k) src dst count >> go True  (k+1)
   | otherwise  = when swap (VGM.unsafeCopy src dst)
{-# INLINE radSort_loop #-}


radSort_body :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
     => (e -> Int)                   -- radix function
     -> v (PrimState m) e            -- source array
     -> v (PrimState m) e            -- destination array
     -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -- radix count
     -> m ()
radSort_body rdx src dst count = do
  radSort_countLoop rdx src count
  radSort_accum count
  radSort_moveLoop rdx src dst count
{-# INLINE radSort_body #-}

radSort_accum :: (PrimMonad m)
           => VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
radSort_accum count = go 0 0
 where
 len = VPM.length count
 go i !acc
   | i < len   = do ci <- VPM.unsafeRead count i
                    VPM.unsafeWrite count i acc
                    go (i+1) (acc + ci)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE radSort_accum #-}

radSort_moveLoop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
         => (e -> Int) -> v (PrimState m) e
         -> v (PrimState m) e -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
radSort_moveLoop rdx src dst prefix = go 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go i
   | i < len    = do srci <- VGM.unsafeRead src i
                     pf   <- vec_inc prefix (rdx srci)
                     VGM.unsafeWrite dst pf srci
                     go (i+1)
   | otherwise  = return ()
{-# INLINE radSort_moveLoop #-}


radSort_countLoop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
          => (e -> Int)
          -> v (PrimState m) e -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
radSort_countLoop rdx src count = VPM.set count 0 >> go 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go i
   | i < len    = VGM.unsafeRead src i >>= vec_inc count . rdx >> go (i+1)
   | otherwise  = return ()
{-# INLINE radSort_countLoop #-}


vec_inc :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v Int) => v (PrimState m) Int
        -> Int -> m Int
vec_inc arr i = VGM.unsafeRead arr i
  >>= \e -> VGM.unsafeWrite arr i (e+1) >> return e
{-# INLINE vec_inc #-}

_kruskal :: UnionFind -> Int -> [Edge] -> (Int, UnionFind)

_kruskal uf acc (((a,b),d):abd)
  | same uf a b = _kruskal uf acc abd
  | otherwise = _kruskal (merge uf a b) (acc + d) abd

type Rank = Int

initial :: UnionFind
initial = UnionFind M.empty M.empty

rep :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point
rep uf p
  | M.notMember p (tree uf) = p
  | tree uf M.! p == p = p
  | otherwise = rep uf (tree uf M.! p)

rank :: UnionFind -> Point -> Rank
rank uf p = M.findWithDefault 1 p (rk uf)

merge :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point -> UnionFind
merge uf p q
  | rp1 == rp2 = uf
  | otherwise = UnionFind (M.insert rp2 rp1 (M.insert p2 rp1 (tree uf))) (M.insert rp1 (rk1 + rk2) (rk uf))
  where
    p1 = ordBy uf p q
    p2 = if p1 == p then q else p
    rp1 = rep uf p1
    rp2 = rep uf p2
    rk1 = rank uf rp1
    rk2 = rank uf rp2

same :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point -> Bool
same uf p1 p2 = rep uf p1 == rep uf p2

ordBy :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point -> Point
ordBy uf x y
  | rx > ry = x
  | rx < ry = y
  | rep uf x < rep uf y = x
  | otherwise = y
  where
    rx = rank uf x
    ry = rank uf y

type UnionFindST s = STArray s Int (Int,Int)

newUFST :: Int -> ST s (UnionFindST s)
newUFST n = newListArray (1,n) (zip [1..n] (repeat 1))

findUFST :: Int -> UnionFindST s -> ST s Int
findUFST x uf = do
  (parent,size) <- readArray uf x
  if parent == x then
    return x
    else do
    next <- findUFST parent uf
    writeArray uf x (next,size)
    return next

sameUFST :: Int -> Int -> UnionFindST s -> ST s Bool
sameUFST x y uf = do
  xx <- findUFST x uf
  yy <- findUFST y uf
  return $ xx == yy

uniteUFST :: Int -> Int -> UnionFindST s -> ST s ()
uniteUFST x y uf = do
  xx <- findUFST x uf
  yy <- findUFST y uf
  (_,xs) <- readArray uf xx
  (_,ys) <- readArray uf yy

  if xx == yy then
    return ()
    else if xs < ys then do
    writeArray uf xx (yy,0)
    else if xs > ys then do
    writeArray uf yy (xx,0)
    else do
    writeArray uf yy (xx,0)
    writeArray uf xx (xx,xs+1)

type Node = Int
type Cost = Int
type Edge = (Node, Node, Cost)

kruskal :: [Node] -> [Edge] -> [Edge]
kruskal nodes edges = runST $ do
  let sorted = sortBy (\(_,_,c1) (_,_,c2) -> compare c1 c2) edges
  uf <- newUFST (length nodes)
  execStateT (kruskal' uf sorted) []
  where
    kruskal' _ [] = return ()
    kruskal' uf (e@(i,j,c):rest) = do
      isSame <- lift $ sameUFST i j uf
      unless isSame $ do
        lift $ uniteUFST i j uf
        modify (e:)
      kruskal' uf rest

type MUFTree s = VUM.MVector s Int
type UFTree = VU.Vector Int

initMUF :: Int -> ST s (MUFTree s)
{-# INLINE initMUF #-}
initMUF len = VUM.replicate len minBound

findUF :: MUFTree s -> Int -> ST s Int
{-# INLINE findUF #-}
findUF vec j = do
  vj <- VUM.read vec j
  if vj < 0 then
    return j
  else do
    root <- findUF vec vj
    VUM.write vec j root
    return root
 
unionUF :: MUFTree s -> Int -> Int -> ST s Bool
{-# INLINE unionUF #-}
unionUF vec i j = do
  rooti <- findUF vec i
  rootj <- findUF vec j
  if rooti == rootj then
    return False
  else do
    ranki <- VUM.read vec rooti
    rankj <- VUM.read vec rootj
    case compare ranki rankj of
      LT ->    VUM.write vec rootj rooti
      GT ->    VUM.write vec rooti rootj
      EQ -> do VUM.write vec rootj rooti
               VUM.write vec rooti (ranki+1)
    return True

radSortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
       => Int               -- ^ the number of passes
       -> Int               -- ^ the size of auxiliary arrays
       -> (Int -> e -> Int) -- ^ the radix function
       -> v (PrimState m) e -- ^ the array to be sorted
       -> m ()
radSortBy passes size rdx arr = do
  tmp    <- VGM.new (VGM.length arr)
  count  <- VPM.new size
  radSort_loop passes rdx arr tmp count
{-# INLINE radSortBy #-}



radSort_loop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
          => Int                          -- passes
          -> (Int -> e -> Int)            -- radix function
          -> v (PrimState m) e            -- array to sort
          -> v (PrimState m) e            -- temporary array
          -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -- radix count array
          -> m ()
radSort_loop passes rdx src dst count = go False 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go swap k
   | k < passes = if swap
                    then radSort_body rdx dst src count k >> go (not swap) (k+1)
                    else radSort_body rdx src dst count k >> go (not swap) (k+1)
   | otherwise  = when swap (VGM.unsafeCopy src dst)
{-# INLINE radSort_loop #-}


radSort_body :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
     => (Int -> e -> Int)            -- radix function
     -> v (PrimState m) e            -- source array
     -> v (PrimState m) e            -- destination array
     -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -- radix count
     -> Int                          -- current pass
     -> m ()
radSort_body rdx src dst count k = do
  radSort_countLoop (rdx k) src count
  radSort_accum count
  radSort_moveLoop k rdx src dst count
{-# INLINE radSort_body #-}

radSort_accum :: (PrimMonad m)
           => VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
radSort_accum count = go 0 0
 where
 len = VPM.length count
 go i acc
   | i < len   = do ci <- VPM.unsafeRead count i
                    VPM.unsafeWrite count i acc
                    go (i+1) (acc + ci)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE radSort_accum #-}

radSort_moveLoop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
         => Int -> (Int -> e -> Int) -> v (PrimState m) e
         -> v (PrimState m) e -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
radSort_moveLoop k rdx src dst prefix = go 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go i
   | i < len    = do srci <- VGM.unsafeRead src i
                     pf   <- vec_inc prefix (rdx k srci)
                     VGM.unsafeWrite dst pf srci
                     go (i+1)
   | otherwise  = return ()
{-# INLINE radSort_moveLoop #-}


radSort_countLoop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
          => (e -> Int)
          -> v (PrimState m) e -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
radSort_countLoop rdx src count = VPM.set count 0 >> go 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go i
   | i < len    = VGM.unsafeRead src i >>= vec_inc count . rdx >> go (i+1)
   | otherwise  = return ()
{-# INLINE radSort_countLoop #-}


vec_inc :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v Int) => v (PrimState m) Int -> Int -> m Int
vec_inc arr i = VGM.unsafeRead arr i
  >>= \e -> VGM.unsafeWrite arr i (e+1) >> return e
{-# INLINE vec_inc #-}

kruskal n edge = makepath m0 0 edge
  where
    m0 = M.fromDistinctAscList (zip [1..n] [1..n])
    makepath _ acc [] = acc
    makepath forest acc (((a,b),d):abd)
      | rep1 /= rep2 = makepath forest1 (d+acc) abd
      | otherwise = makepath forest acc abd
      where
        v1 = min a b
        v2 = max a b
        rep1 = untilFix (forest!) v1
        rep2 = untilFix (forest!) v2
        forest1 = M.insert v2 rep1 (M.insert rep2 rep1 forest)

    edgey = zipWith mkedge xysy (tail xysy)

          -> v (PrimState m) e            -- temporary array

   | k < passes = if swap
                    then radSort_body (rdx k) dst src count >> go False (k+1)
                    else radSort_body (rdx k) src dst count >> go True  (k+1)
   | otherwise  = when swap (VGM.unsafeCopy src dst)
{-# INLINE radSort_loop #-}


radSort_body :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
     => (e -> Int)                   -- radix function
     -> v (PrimState m) e            -- source array
     -> v (PrimState m) e            -- destination array
     -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -- radix count
     -> m ()
radSort_body rdx src dst count = do
  radSort_countLoop rdx src count
  radSort_accum count
  radSort_moveLoop rdx src dst count
{-# INLINE radSort_body #-}

radSort_accum :: (PrimMonad m)
           => VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
radSort_accum count = go 0 0
 where
 len = VPM.length count
 go i !acc
   | i < len   = do ci <- VPM.unsafeRead count i
                    VPM.unsafeWrite count i acc
                    go (i+1) (acc + ci)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE radSort_accum #-}

radSort_moveLoop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
         => (e -> Int) -> v (PrimState m) e
         -> v (PrimState m) e -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
radSort_moveLoop rdx src dst prefix = go 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go i
   | i < len    = do srci <- VGM.unsafeRead src i
                     pf   <- vec_inc prefix (rdx srci)
                     VGM.unsafeWrite dst pf srci
                     go (i+1)
   | otherwise  = return ()
{-# INLINE radSort_moveLoop #-}


radSort_countLoop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
          => (e -> Int)
          -> v (PrimState m) e -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
radSort_countLoop rdx src count = VPM.set count 0 >> go 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go i
   | i < len    = VGM.unsafeRead src i >>= vec_inc count . rdx >> go (i+1)
   | otherwise  = return ()
{-# INLINE radSort_countLoop #-}


vec_inc :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v Int) => v (PrimState m) Int
        -> Int -> m Int
vec_inc arr i = VGM.unsafeRead arr i
  >>= \e -> VGM.unsafeWrite arr i (e+1) >> return e
{-# INLINE vec_inc #-}

kruskal n = kruskalDP n uf0 0 0
  where

kruskalDP _ _ acc _ [] = acc

data UnionFind = UnionFind {tree :: M.IntMap Point, rk :: M.IntMap Rank}
type Point = Int
type Rank = Int

rep :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point
rep uf = (M.!) (tree uf)

rank :: UnionFind -> Point -> Rank
rank uf = (M.!) (rk uf)

merge :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point -> UnionFind
merge uf p1 p2
  | r1 /= r2 && rank uf r1 > rank uf r2 = UnionFind (M.insert p2 r1 (M.insert r2 r1 (tree uf))) (M.insert r1 (r1 + r2) (rk uf)) 
  | r1 /= r2 = UnionFind (M.insert p1 r2 (M.insert r1 r2 (tree uf))) (M.insert r2 (r1 + r2) (rk uf)) 
  | otherwise = uf
  where
    r1 = untilFix (rep uf) p1
    r2 = untilFix (rep uf) p2

same :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point -> Bool
same uf p1 p2 = untilFix (rep uf) p1 == untilFix (rep uf) p2

fromDistinctAscList :: [Point] -> UnionFind
fromDistinctAscList ps = UnionFind tree0 rk0
  where
    tree0 = M.fromDistinctAscList [(i,i) | i <- ps]
    rk0 = M.fromDistinctAscList [(i,1) | i <- ps]

main :: IO ()
main = do
    n <- read <$> getLine
    ps <- replicateM n
        ((\[x , y] -> (x, y)) . map read . words <$> getLine)
    let dss = map (\p -> tail $
                         sortBy (\(_, a) (_, b) -> compare a b) $
                         zip ([0..] :: [Int]) $
                         map (cost p) ps) ps
    -- print dss
    print $ f 0 dss

    where
        f :: Int -> [[(Int, Int)]] -> Int
        f _ [] = 0
        f _ [_] = 0
        f i (xs:yss) = case xs of
            [] -> 0
            (j, c):_ -> c + f (i + 1) (mapAt (deleteI i) j yss)


cost :: (Int, Int) -> (Int, Int) -> Int
cost (ax, ay) (bx, by) = min (abs $ ax - bx) (abs $ ay - by)

mapAt :: (a -> a) -> Int -> [a] -> [a]
mapAt _ _ []     = []
mapAt f 0 (x:xs) = f x : xs
mapAt f i (x:xs) = x : mapAt f (i - 1) xs

deleteI :: Eq a => a -> [(a, b)] -> [(a, b)]
deleteI _ [] = []
deleteI a ((a', b):xs) =
    if a == a' then xs
    else (a', b): deleteI a xs

  where

    iys = VU.create $ do

type MUFTree s = VUM.MVector s Int
type UFTree = VU.Vector Int

initMUF :: Int -> ST s (MUFTree s)
initMUF len = VUM.replicate len minBound

findUF :: MUFTree s -> Int -> ST s Int
{-# INLINE findUF #-}
findUF vec j = do
  vj <- VUM.read vec j
  if vj < 0 then
    return j
  else do
    root <- findUF vec vj
    VUM.write vec j root
    return root
 
unionUF :: MUFTree s -> Int -> Int -> ST s Bool
unionUF vec i j = do
  rooti <- findUF vec i
  rootj <- findUF vec j
  if rooti == rootj then
    return False
  else do
    ranki <- VUM.read vec rooti
    rankj <- VUM.read vec rootj
    case compare ranki rankj of
      LT -> do VUM.write vec rootj rooti
      GT -> do VUM.write vec rooti rootj
      EQ -> do VUM.write vec rootj rooti
               VUM.write vec rooti (ranki+1)
    return True

radSortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
       => Int               -- ^ the number of passes
       -> Int               -- ^ the size of auxiliary arrays
       -> (Int -> e -> Int) -- ^ the radix function
       -> v (PrimState m) e -- ^ the array to be sorted
       -> m ()
radSortBy passes size rdx arr = do
  tmp    <- VGM.new (VGM.length arr)
  count  <- VPM.new size
  radSort_loop passes rdx arr tmp count
{-# INLINE radSortBy #-}



radSort_loop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
          => Int                          -- passes
          -> (Int -> e -> Int)            -- radix function
          -> v (PrimState m) e            -- array to sort
          -> v (PrimState m) e            -- temporary array
          -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -- radix count array
          -> m ()
radSort_loop passes rdx src dst count = go False 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go swap k
   | k < passes = if swap
                    then radSort_body rdx dst src count k >> go (not swap) (k+1)
                    else radSort_body rdx src dst count k >> go (not swap) (k+1)
   | otherwise  = when swap (VGM.unsafeCopy src dst)
{-# INLINE radSort_loop #-}


radSort_body :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
     => (Int -> e -> Int)            -- radix function
     -> v (PrimState m) e            -- source array
     -> v (PrimState m) e            -- destination array
     -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -- radix count
     -> Int                          -- current pass
     -> m ()
radSort_body rdx src dst count k = do
  radSort_countLoop (rdx k) src count
  radSort_accum count
  radSort_moveLoop k rdx src dst count
{-# INLINE radSort_body #-}

radSort_accum :: (PrimMonad m)
           => VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
radSort_accum count = go 0 0
 where
 len = VPM.length count
 go i acc
   | i < len   = do ci <- VPM.unsafeRead count i
                    VPM.unsafeWrite count i acc
                    go (i+1) (acc + ci)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE radSort_accum #-}

radSort_moveLoop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
         => Int -> (Int -> e -> Int) -> v (PrimState m) e
         -> v (PrimState m) e -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
radSort_moveLoop k rdx src dst prefix = go 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go i
   | i < len    = do srci <- VGM.unsafeRead src i
                     pf   <- vec_inc prefix (rdx k srci)
                     VGM.unsafeWrite dst pf srci
                     go (i+1)
   | otherwise  = return ()
{-# INLINE radSort_moveLoop #-}


radSort_countLoop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
          => (e -> Int)
          -> v (PrimState m) e -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
radSort_countLoop rdx src count = VPM.set count 0 >> go 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go i
   | i < len    = VGM.unsafeRead src i >>= vec_inc count . rdx >> go (i+1)
   | otherwise  = return ()
{-# INLINE radSort_countLoop #-}


vec_inc :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v Int) => v (PrimState m) Int -> Int -> m Int
vec_inc arr i = VGM.unsafeRead arr i
  >>= \e -> VGM.unsafeWrite arr i (e+1) >> return e
{-# INLINE vec_inc #-}

kruskalIO (n,edge) = do
 forest <- newListArray (0,n-1) [0..n-1] :: IO (IOUArray Int Int)
 rank <- newArray (0,n-1) 1 :: IO (IOUArray Int Int)
 ret <- foldM makepath ((forest,rank),0) edge
 return ret

makepath ((forest,rank),acc) ((a,b),d) = do
 rep1 <- untilFixM (readArray forest) a
 rank1 <- readArray rank rep1
 rep2 <- untilFixM (readArray forest) b
 rank2 <- readArray rank rep2
 if rep1 /= rep2
  then if rank1 >= rank2
   then do
    writeArray forest rep2 rep1
    writeArray forest b rep1
    writeArray rank rep1 (rank1+rank2)
    return ((forest,rank), acc+d)
   else do
    writeArray forest rep1 rep2
    writeArray forest a rep2
    writeArray rank rep2 (rank1+rank2)
    return ((forest,rank), acc+d)    
  else do
   return ((forest,rank), acc)

type UnionFindIO = IOArray Int Int

newUFIO :: Int -> IO UnionFindIO
newUFIO n = newListArray (1,n) [1..n]

findUFIO :: Int -> UnionFindIO -> IO Int
findUFIO x uf = do
  parent <- readArray uf x
  if parent == x then
    return x
    else do
    next <- findUFIO parent uf
    writeArray uf x next
    return next

sameUFIO :: Int -> Int -> UnionFindIO -> IO Bool
sameUFIO x y uf = do
  xx <- findUFIO x uf
  yy <- findUFIO y uf
  return $ xx == yy

unionUFIO :: Int -> Int -> UnionFindIO -> IO ()
unionUFIO x y uf = do
  xx <- findUFIO x uf
  yy <- findUFIO y uf

  if xx == yy then
    return ()
    else
    writeArray uf x y


type City = (Int,(Int,Int))

kruskal :: [City] -> [(City,City)] -> IO Int
kruskal nodes edges = do
  let sorted = sortBy comp (map (\((i,ci),(j,cj)) -> (i,j,dist ci cj)) edges)

  uf <- newUFIO (length nodes)

  let
    kruskal' [] = return []
    kruskal' (e@(i,j,c):es) = do
      same <- sameUFIO i j uf
      if same then
        kruskal' es
        else do
        unionUFIO i j uf
        kruskal' es >>= \list -> return $ c : list
        
  kruskal' sorted >>= return . sum
  where
    comp (_,_,c1) (_,_,c2) = compare c1 c2
    dist (x1,y1) (x2,y2) = min (abs $ x1-x2) (abs $ y1-y2)

put = C.pack . show

sol v = kruskal n (ex++ey)
  where
  n = head v
  u = tail v
  vs = generate n id
  ex = es x $ modify (sortBy (comparing x)) vs
  ey = es y $ modify (sortBy (comparing y)) vs
  x i = u!(2*i)
  y i = u!(2*i+1)
  es f is = zipWith (\i j -> (f i-f j,i,j)) (tail is) is

data UnionFind s = UnionFind {ids :: UM.STVector s Int, szs :: UM.STVector s Int}

newUF n = liftM2 UnionFind (unsafeThaw $ enumFromTo 0 (n-1)) (UM.replicate n 1)

findUF uf p q = liftM2 (==) (rootUF uf p) (rootUF uf q)

rootUF uf i = do
  p <- UM.unsafeRead (ids uf) i
  if p==i
    then return i
    else do
      gp <- UM.unsafeRead (ids uf) p
      if gp==p
        then return p
        else do
          UM.unsafeWrite (ids uf) i gp
          rootUF uf i

uniteUF uf p q = do
  i <- rootUF uf p
  j <- rootUF uf q
  si <- UM.unsafeRead (szs uf) i
  sj <- UM.unsafeRead (szs uf) j
  if si<sj
    then do
      UM.unsafeWrite (ids uf) i j
      UM.unsafeWrite (szs uf) j (si+sj)
    else do
      UM.unsafeWrite (ids uf) j i
      UM.unsafeWrite (szs uf) i (si+sj)

kruskal n = go n . modify sort

go n es = runST $ do
  uf <- newUF n
  a <- newSTRef 0
  foldM'_ upd (uf,a) es
  readSTRef a

upd (uf,a) (c,i,j) = do
  b <- findUF uf i j
  unless b $ do
    uniteUF uf i j
    modifySTRef' a (+c)
  return (uf,a)

main :: IO ()
main = do
  n <- read <$> getLine
  vs <- VU.unfoldrN n (runStateT $ (,) <$> rInt <*> rInt) <$> BSL.getContents
  print $ query vs    

rInt :: StateT BSL.ByteString Maybe Int
rInt = StateT $ BSL.readInt . BSL.dropWhile (<'!')

  
query :: VU.Vector (Int,Int) -> Int
query vs = runST $ do
  uf <- initMUF $ VU.length vs
  VU.foldr
    (\(i,j,d) cont !acc -> do
        merged <- unionUF uf i j
        if merged then cont (acc+d) else cont acc)
    (return $!)
    (edges vs)
    0

edges :: VU.Vector (Int,Int) -> VU.Vector (Int,Int,Int)
edges vs = VU.create $ do
  vec <- VU.unsafeThaw $ xedges VU.++ yedges
  radSortBy 4 256 (\k -> let !b = k*8 in \(i,j,d) -> shiftR d b .&. 255) vec
  return vec
  where
    (is_x,xs_sorted) = VU.unzip ixs
    xs_diff = VU.zipWith (-) (VU.tail xs_sorted) xs_sorted
    (is_y,ys_sorted) = VU.unzip iys
    ys_diff = VU.zipWith (-) (VU.tail ys_sorted) ys_sorted
    xedges = VU.zip3 is_x (VU.tail is_x) xs_diff
    yedges = VU.zip3 is_y (VU.tail is_y) ys_diff
    ixs = VU.create $ do
      ixs <- VU.unsafeThaw $ VU.indexed xs
      radSortBy 4 256 (\k -> let !b = k*8 in \(i,x) -> shiftR x b .&. 255) ixs
      return ixs
    iys = VU.create $ do
      iys <- VU.unsafeThaw $ VU.indexed ys
      radSortBy 4 256 (\k -> let !b = k*8 in \(i,y) -> shiftR y b .&. 255) iys
      return iys
    (xs,ys) = VU.unzip vs


type MUFTree s = VUM.MVector s Int
type UFTree = VU.Vector Int

initMUF :: Int -> ST s (MUFTree s)
{-# INLINE initMUF #-}
initMUF len = VUM.replicate len minBound

findUF :: MUFTree s -> Int -> ST s Int
{-# INLINE findUF #-}
findUF vec j = do
  vj <- VUM.read vec j
  if vj < 0 then
    return j
  else do
    root <- findUF vec vj
    VUM.write vec j root
    return root
 
unionUF :: MUFTree s -> Int -> Int -> ST s Bool
{-# INLINE unionUF #-}
unionUF vec i j = do
  rooti <- findUF vec i
  rootj <- findUF vec j
  if rooti == rootj then
    return False
  else do
    ranki <- VUM.read vec rooti
    rankj <- VUM.read vec rootj
    case compare ranki rankj of
      LT ->    VUM.write vec rootj rooti
      GT ->    VUM.write vec rooti rootj
      EQ -> do VUM.write vec rootj rooti
               VUM.write vec rooti (ranki+1)
    return True

radSortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
       => Int               -- ^ the number of passes
       -> Int               -- ^ the size of auxiliary arrays
       -> (Int -> e -> Int) -- ^ the radix function
       -> v (PrimState m) e -- ^ the array to be sorted
       -> m ()
radSortBy passes size rdx arr = do
  tmp    <- VGM.new (VGM.length arr)
  count  <- VPM.new size
  radSort_loop passes rdx arr tmp count
{-# INLINE radSortBy #-}



radSort_loop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
          => Int                          -- passes
          -> (Int -> e -> Int)            -- radix function
          -> v (PrimState m) e            -- array to sort
          -> v (PrimState m) e            -- temporary array
          -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -- radix count array
          -> m ()
radSort_loop passes rdx src dst count = go False 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go swap k
   | k < passes = if swap
                    then radSort_body (rdx k) dst src count >> go False (k+1)
                    else radSort_body (rdx k) src dst count >> go True  (k+1)
   | otherwise  = when swap (VGM.unsafeCopy src dst)
{-# INLINE radSort_loop #-}


radSort_body :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
     => (e -> Int)                   -- radix function
     -> v (PrimState m) e            -- source array
     -> v (PrimState m) e            -- destination array
     -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -- radix count
     -> m ()
radSort_body rdx src dst count = do
  radSort_countLoop rdx src count
  radSort_accum count
  radSort_moveLoop rdx src dst count
{-# INLINE radSort_body #-}

radSort_accum :: (PrimMonad m)
           => VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
radSort_accum count = go 0 0
 where
 len = VPM.length count
 go i !acc
   | i < len   = do ci <- VPM.unsafeRead count i
                    VPM.unsafeWrite count i acc
                    go (i+1) (acc + ci)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE radSort_accum #-}

radSort_moveLoop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
         => (e -> Int) -> v (PrimState m) e
         -> v (PrimState m) e -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
radSort_moveLoop rdx src dst prefix = go 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go i
   | i < len    = do srci <- VGM.unsafeRead src i
                     pf   <- vec_inc prefix (rdx srci)
                     VGM.unsafeWrite dst pf srci
                     go (i+1)
   | otherwise  = return ()
{-# INLINE radSort_moveLoop #-}


radSort_countLoop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
          => (e -> Int)
          -> v (PrimState m) e -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
radSort_countLoop rdx src count = VPM.set count 0 >> go 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go i
   | i < len    = VGM.unsafeRead src i >>= vec_inc count . rdx >> go (i+1)
   | otherwise  = return ()
{-# INLINE radSort_countLoop #-}


vec_inc :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v Int) => v (PrimState m) Int
        -> Int -> m Int
vec_inc arr i = VGM.unsafeRead arr i
  >>= \e -> VGM.unsafeWrite arr i (e+1) >> return e
{-# INLINE vec_inc #-}

solve :: Int -> U.Vector (Int, Int) -> Int
solve n ps = kruskal n $ esX U.++ esY
  where
    !xs = U.modify Intro.sort $ U.imap (\i (x, _) -> (x, i)) ps
    !ys = U.modify Intro.sort $ U.imap (\i (_, y) -> (y, i)) ps
    esX = U.zipWith (\(x, i) (x', j) -> (i, j, abs (x' - x))) xs $ U.tail xs
    esY = U.zipWith (\(y, i) (y', j) -> (i, j, abs (y' - y))) ys $ U.tail ys

kruskal :: (U.Unbox w, Ord w, Num w) => Int -> U.Vector (Int, Int, w) -> w
kruskal n es = runST $ do
    uf <- newUnionFind n
    U.foldM'
        (\acc (i, j, w) -> do
            uniteUF uf i j >>= \case
                False -> return acc
                True -> uniteUF uf i j >> return (acc + w)
            )
        0
        (U.modify (Intro.sortBy (\(_, _, w) (_, _, w') -> compare w w')) es)

rep :: (Monad m) => Int -> (Int -> m ()) -> m ()
rep n = flip MS.mapM_ (stream 0 n)

rev :: (Monad m) => Int -> (Int -> m ()) -> m ()

stream :: (Monad m) => Int -> Int -> MS.Stream m Int
stream !l !r = MS.Stream step l where { step x | x < r = return $ MS.Yield x (x + 1) | otherwise = return MS.Done; {-# INLINE [0] step #-}}
{-# INLINE [1] stream #-}
streamR :: (Monad m) => Int -> Int -> MS.Stream m Int
streamR !l !r = MS.Stream step (r - 1) where { step x | x >= l = return $ MS.Yield x (x - 1) | otherwise = return MS.Done; {-# INLINE [0] step #-}}
{-# INLINE [1] streamR #-}
stream' :: (Monad m) => Int -> Int -> Int -> MS.Stream m Int
stream' !l !r !d = MS.Stream step l where { step x | x < r = return $ MS.Yield x (x + d) | otherwise = return MS.Done; {-# INLINE [0] step #-}}

lowerBoundM :: (Monad m) => Int -> Int -> (Int -> m Bool) -> m Int
lowerBoundM low high p = go low high where { go !low !high | high <= low = return high | otherwise = p mid >>= bool (go (mid + 1) high) (go low mid) where { mid = low + unsafeShiftRL (high - low) 1}}
{-# INLINE lowerBoundM #-}
upperBoundM :: (Monad m) => Int -> Int -> (Int -> m Bool) -> m Int
upperBoundM low high p = do { flg <- p high; if flg then return high else subtract 1 <$!> lowerBoundM low high (fmap not . p)}
{-# INLINE upperBoundM #-}
lowerBound :: Int -> Int -> (Int -> Bool) -> Int
lowerBound low high p = runIdentity (lowerBoundM low high (return . p))
{-# INLINE lowerBound #-}
upperBound :: Int -> Int -> (Int -> Bool) -> Int
upperBound low high p = runIdentity (upperBoundM low high (return . p))
{-# INLINE upperBound #-}

newtype UnionFind s = UF{internalUF :: UM.MVector s Int}
newUnionFind :: PrimMonad m => Int -> m (UnionFind (PrimState m))
newUnionFind n = UF <$> UM.replicate n (-1)
{-# INLINE newUnionFind #-}
freezeUnionFind :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> m (U.Vector Int)
freezeUnionFind = U.unsafeFreeze . internalUF
findUF :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> Int -> m Int
findUF uf x = go x return where { go !x k = do { px <- UM.unsafeRead (internalUF uf) x; if px < 0 then k x else go px $ \ ppx -> do { UM.unsafeWrite (internalUF uf) x ppx; k ppx}}}
{-# INLINE findUF #-}
sizeUF :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> Int -> m Int
sizeUF uf = fix $ \ loop x -> do { px <- UM.unsafeRead (internalUF uf) x; if px < 0 then return $! negate px else loop px}
{-# INLINE sizeUF #-}
uniteUF :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> Int -> Int -> m Bool
uniteUF uf x y = do { px <- findUF uf x; py <- findUF uf y; if px == py then return False else do { rx <- UM.unsafeRead (internalUF uf) px; ry <- UM.unsafeRead (internalUF uf) py; if rx < ry then do { UM.unsafeModify (internalUF uf) (+ ry) px; UM.unsafeWrite (internalUF uf) py px} else do { UM.unsafeModify (internalUF uf) (+ rx) py; UM.unsafeWrite (internalUF uf) px py}; return True}}
{-# INLINE uniteUF #-}
equivUF :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> Int -> Int -> m Bool
equivUF uf x y = (==) `liftM` findUF uf x `ap` findUF uf y
{-# INLINE equivUF #-}
countGroupUF :: PrimMonad m => UnionFind (PrimState m) -> m Int
countGroupUF uf = U.length . U.filter (< 0) <$> freezeUnionFind uf
{-# INLINE countGroupUF #-}

import Data.Array.IO

type UnionFindIO = IOUArray Int Int

newUFIO :: Int -> IO UnionFindIO
newUFIO n = newListArray (1,n) [1..n]

findUFIO :: Int -> UnionFindIO -> IO Int
findUFIO x uf = do
  parent <- readArray uf x
  if parent == x then
    return x
    else do
    next <- findUFIO parent uf
    writeArray uf x next
    return next

sameUFIO :: Int -> Int -> UnionFindIO -> IO Bool
sameUFIO x y uf = do
  xx <- findUFIO x uf
  yy <- findUFIO y uf
  return $ xx == yy

unionUFIO :: Int -> Int -> UnionFindIO -> IO ()
unionUFIO x y uf = do
  xx <- findUFIO x uf
  yy <- findUFIO y uf

  if xx == yy then
    return ()
    else
    writeArray uf x y


type City = (Int,(Integer,Integer))

kruskal :: [City] -> [(City,City)] -> IO Integer
kruskal nodes edges = do
  let sorted = sortBy comp (map (\((i,ci),(j,cj)) -> (i,j,dist ci cj)) edges)

  uf <- newUFIO (length nodes)

  let
    kruskal' [] = return 0
    kruskal' (e@(i,j,c):es) = do
      same <- sameUFIO i j uf
      if same then
        kruskal' es
        else do
        unionUFIO i j uf
        kruskal' es >>= \x -> return $ c + x
        
  kruskal' sorted
  where
    comp (_,_,c1) (_,_,c2) = compare c1 c2
    dist (x1,y1) (x2,y2) = min (abs $ x1-x2) (abs $ y1-y2)

kruskalDP _ _ acc _ [] = acc

data UnionFind = UnionFind {tree :: IM.IntMap Point, rk :: IM.IntMap Rank}
type Point = Int
type Rank = Int

initial :: UnionFind
initial = UnionFind (IM.singleton 0 0) IM.empty

(!?) :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point
(!?) uf p = IM.findWithDefault 0 p (tree uf)

rep :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point
rep uf = untilFix (uf !?)

rank :: UnionFind -> Point -> Rank
rank uf = (rk uf IM.!)

isolate :: UnionFind -> Point -> Bool
isolate uf p = rep uf p == 0

merge :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point -> UnionFind
merge uf p1 p2
  | i1 && i2 = UnionFind (IM.insert p2 p1 (IM.insert p1 p1 (tree uf))) (IM.insert p1 2 (rk uf))
  | i1 = UnionFind (IM.insert p1 rp2 (tree uf)) (IM.insert rp2 (rk2 + 1) (rk uf))
  | i2 = UnionFind (IM.insert p2 rp1 (tree uf)) (IM.insert rp1 (rk1 + 1) (rk uf))
  | rp1 /= rp2 && rk1 > rk2 = UnionFind (IM.insert p2 rp1 (IM.insert rp2 rp1 (tree uf))) (IM.insert rp1 (rk1 + rk2) (rk uf))
  | rp1 /= rp2 = UnionFind (IM.insert p1 rp2 (IM.insert rp1 rp2 (tree uf))) (IM.insert rp2 (rk1 + rk2) (rk uf))
  | otherwise = uf
  where
    i1 = isolate uf p1
    i2 = isolate uf p2
    rk1 = rank uf rp1
    rk2 = rank uf rp2
    rp1 = rep uf p1
    rp2 = rep uf p2

same :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point -> Bool
same uf p1 p2
  | p1 == p2 = True
  | otherwise = not (isolate uf p1) && (rep uf p1 == rep uf p2)

data UnionFind = UnionFind {tree :: M.IntMap Point, rk :: M.IntMap Rank}
type Point = Int
type Rank = Int

(!?) :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point
(!?) uf p = M.findWithDefault 0 p (tree uf)

rep :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point
rep uf = untilFix (uf !?)

rank :: UnionFind -> Point -> Rank
rank uf = (rk uf M.!)

isolate :: UnionFind -> Point -> Bool
isolate uf p = uf !? p == 0

merge :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point -> UnionFind
merge uf p1 p2
  | isolate uf p1 && isolate uf p2 = UnionFind (M.insert p2 p1 (M.insert p1 p1 (tree uf))) (M.insert p1 2 (rk uf))
  | isolate uf p1 = UnionFind (M.insert p1 rp2 (tree uf)) (M.insert rp2 (rk2 + 1) (rk uf))
  | isolate uf p2 = UnionFind (M.insert p2 rp1 (tree uf)) (M.insert rp1 (rk1 + 1) (rk uf))
  | rp1 /= rp2 && rk1 > rk2 = UnionFind (M.insert p2 rp1 (M.insert rp2 rp1 (tree uf))) (M.insert rp1 (rk1 + rk2) (rk uf))
  | rp1 /= rp2 = UnionFind (M.insert p1 rp2 (M.insert rp1 rp2 (tree uf))) (M.insert rp2 (rk1 + rk2) (rk uf))
  | otherwise = uf
  where
    rk1 = rank uf rp1
    rk2 = rank uf rp2
    rp1 = rep uf p1
    rp2 = rep uf p2

same :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point -> Bool
same uf p1 p2 = not (isolate uf p1) && rep uf p1 == rep uf p2

greedy :: IOUArray Int Int -> [(Int, Int, Int)] -> Int -> Int -> IO Int
greedy parent ((i, j, w):es) n k
  | n == k    = return 0
  | otherwise = do
    pI <- readArray parent i
    pJ <- readArray parent j
    if pI == pJ then greedy parent es n k
                else do
                  writeArray parent pI pJ
                  sum <- greedy parent es n $ k + 1
                  return $ w + sum

rInt :: StateT BSL.ByteString Maybe Int
rInt = StateT $ BSL.readInt . BSL.dropWhile (<'!')

query :: Int -> BSL.ByteString -> Int
query n bs = runST $ do
  uf <- initMUF n
  VU.foldr
    (\(i,j,d) cont !acc -> do
        merged <- unionUF uf i j
        if merged then cont (acc+d) else cont acc)
    (return $!)
    (edges n bs)
    0

edges :: Int -> BSL.ByteString -> VU.Vector (Int,Int,Int)
edges n !bs = VU.create $ do
  ixys <- VUM.unsafeNew $ n `shiftL` 1
  foldr (\ !i cont !input0 -> do
    let Just (!xi, !input1) = BSL.readInt $ BSL.dropWhile (<'!') input0
        Just (!yi, !input2) = BSL.readInt $ BSL.dropWhile (<'!') input1
    VUM.unsafeWrite ixys    i  (i,xi)
    VUM.unsafeWrite ixys (n+i) (i,yi)
    cont input2)
    (\ !input -> return ())
    [0..n-1] bs
  radSortBy 4 256 (\k -> let !b = k*8 in \(i,x) -> shiftR x b .&. 255)
    $ VUM.unsafeTake n ixys
  radSortBy 4 256 (\k -> let !b = k*8 in \(i,y) -> shiftR y b .&. 255)
    $ VUM.unsafeDrop n ixys
  let (is, xys) = VUM.unzip ixys
  forM_ [0..2*n-2] $ \i -> do
    v_ip1 <- VUM.unsafeRead xys $ i+1
    VUM.unsafeModify xys (v_ip1-) i
  VUM.unsafeWrite xys (n-1) (2^32-1)
  js <- VUM.clone $ VUM.tail is
  let ijds = VUM.zip3 is js xys
  radSortBy 4 256 (\k -> let !b = k*8 in \(i,j,d) -> shiftR d b .&. 255) ijds
  return ijds


type MUFTree s = VUM.MVector s Int
type UFTree = VU.Vector Int

initMUF :: Int -> ST s (MUFTree s)
{-# INLINE initMUF #-}
initMUF len = VUM.replicate len minBound

findUF :: MUFTree s -> Int -> ST s Int
{-# INLINE findUF #-}
findUF vec j = do
  vj <- VUM.read vec j
  if vj < 0 then
    return j
  else do
    root <- findUF vec vj
    VUM.write vec j root
    return root
 
unionUF :: MUFTree s -> Int -> Int -> ST s Bool
{-# INLINE unionUF #-}
unionUF vec i j = do
  rooti <- findUF vec i
  rootj <- findUF vec j
  if rooti == rootj then
    return False
  else do
    ranki <- VUM.read vec rooti
    rankj <- VUM.read vec rootj
    case compare ranki rankj of
      LT ->    VUM.write vec rootj rooti
      GT ->    VUM.write vec rooti rootj
      EQ -> do VUM.write vec rootj rooti
               VUM.write vec rooti (ranki+1)
    return True

radSortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
       => Int               -- ^ the number of passes
       -> Int               -- ^ the size of auxiliary arrays
       -> (Int -> e -> Int) -- ^ the radix function
       -> v (PrimState m) e -- ^ the array to be sorted
       -> m ()
radSortBy passes size rdx arr = do
  tmp    <- VGM.new (VGM.length arr)
  count  <- VPM.new size
  radSort_loop passes rdx arr tmp count
{-# INLINE radSortBy #-}



radSort_loop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
          => Int                          -- passes
          -> (Int -> e -> Int)            -- radix function
          -> v (PrimState m) e            -- array to sort
          -> v (PrimState m) e            -- temporary array
          -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -- radix count array
          -> m ()
radSort_loop passes rdx src dst count = go False 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go swap k
   | k < passes = if swap
                    then radSort_body (rdx k) dst src count >> go False (k+1)
                    else radSort_body (rdx k) src dst count >> go True  (k+1)
   | otherwise  = when swap (VGM.unsafeCopy src dst)
{-# INLINE radSort_loop #-}


radSort_body :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
     => (e -> Int)                   -- radix function
     -> v (PrimState m) e            -- source array
     -> v (PrimState m) e            -- destination array
     -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -- radix count
     -> m ()
radSort_body rdx src dst count = do
  radSort_countLoop rdx src count
  radSort_accum count
  radSort_moveLoop rdx src dst count
{-# INLINE radSort_body #-}

radSort_accum :: (PrimMonad m)
           => VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
radSort_accum count = go 0 0
 where
 len = VPM.length count
 go i !acc
   | i < len   = do ci <- VPM.unsafeRead count i
                    VPM.unsafeWrite count i acc
                    go (i+1) (acc + ci)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE radSort_accum #-}

radSort_moveLoop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
         => (e -> Int) -> v (PrimState m) e
         -> v (PrimState m) e -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
radSort_moveLoop rdx src dst prefix = go 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go i
   | i < len    = do srci <- VGM.unsafeRead src i
                     pf   <- vec_inc prefix (rdx srci)
                     VGM.unsafeWrite dst pf srci
                     go (i+1)
   | otherwise  = return ()
{-# INLINE radSort_moveLoop #-}


radSort_countLoop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
          => (e -> Int)
          -> v (PrimState m) e -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
radSort_countLoop rdx src count = VPM.set count 0 >> go 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go i
   | i < len    = VGM.unsafeRead src i >>= vec_inc count . rdx >> go (i+1)
   | otherwise  = return ()
{-# INLINE radSort_countLoop #-}


vec_inc :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v Int) => v (PrimState m) Int
        -> Int -> m Int
vec_inc arr i = VGM.unsafeRead arr i
  >>= \e -> VGM.unsafeWrite arr i (e+1) >> return e
{-# INLINE vec_inc #-}

data UnionFind = UnionFind {tree :: M.IntMap Point, rk :: M.IntMap Rank}
type Point = Int
type Rank = Int

initial :: UnionFind
initial = UnionFind (M.singleton 0 0) M.empty

(!?) :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point
(!?) uf p = M.findWithDefault 0 p (tree uf)

rep :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point
rep uf = untilFix (uf !?)

rank :: UnionFind -> Point -> Rank
rank uf = (rk uf M.!)

isolate :: UnionFind -> Point -> Bool
isolate uf p = rep uf p == 0

merge :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point -> UnionFind
merge uf p1 p2
  | i1 && i2 = UnionFind (M.insert p2 p1 (M.insert p1 p1 (tree uf))) (M.insert p1 2 (rk uf))
  | i1 = UnionFind (M.insert p1 rp2 (tree uf)) (M.insert rp2 (rk2 + 1) (rk uf))
  | i2 = UnionFind (M.insert p2 rp1 (tree uf)) (M.insert rp1 (rk1 + 1) (rk uf))
  | rp1 /= rp2 && rk1 > rk2 = UnionFind (M.insert p2 rp1 (M.insert rp2 rp1 (tree uf))) (M.insert rp1 (rk1 + rk2) (rk uf))
  | rp1 /= rp2 = UnionFind (M.insert p1 rp2 (M.insert rp1 rp2 (tree uf))) (M.insert rp2 (rk1 + rk2) (rk uf))
  | otherwise = uf
  where
    i1 = isolate uf p1
    i2 = isolate uf p2
    rk1 = rank uf rp1
    rk2 = rank uf rp2
    rp1 = rep uf p1
    rp2 = rep uf p2

same :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point -> Bool
same uf p1 p2
  | p1 == p2 = True
  | otherwise = not (isolate uf p1) && (rep uf p1 == rep uf p2)

type UnionFindST s = STArray s Int (Int,Int)

newUFST :: Int -> ST s (UnionFindST s)
newUFST n = newListArray (1,n) (zip [1..n] (repeat 1))

findUFST :: Int -> UnionFindST s -> ST s Int
findUFST x uf = do
  (parent,size) <- readArray uf x
  if parent == x then
    return x
    else do
    next <- findUFST parent uf
    writeArray uf x (next,size)
    return next

sameUFST :: Int -> Int -> UnionFindST s -> ST s Bool
sameUFST x y uf = do
  xx <- findUFST x uf
  yy <- findUFST y uf
  return $ xx == yy

uniteUFST :: Int -> Int -> UnionFindST s -> ST s ()
uniteUFST x y uf = do
  xx <- findUFST x uf
  yy <- findUFST y uf
  (_,xs) <- readArray uf xx
  (_,ys) <- readArray uf yy

  if xx == yy then
    return ()
    else if xs < ys then do
    writeArray uf xx (yy,0)
    else if xs > ys then do
    writeArray uf yy (xx,0)
    else do
    writeArray uf yy (xx,0)
    writeArray uf xx (xx,xs+1)

type Node = Int
type Cost = Int
type Edge = (Node, Node, Cost)

kruskal :: [Node] -> [Edge] -> [Edge]
kruskal nodes edges = runST $ do
  let sorted = sortBy (\(_,_,c1) (_,_,c2) -> compare c1 c2) edges
  uf <- newUFST (length nodes)
  execStateT (kruskal' uf sorted) []
  where
    kruskal' _ [] = return ()
    kruskal' uf (e@(i,j,c):rest) = do
      isSame <- lift $ sameUFST i j uf
      unless isSame $ do
        lift $ uniteUFST i j uf
        modify (e:)
      kruskal' uf rest

listToTuple2 (a:b:_) = (a,b)

main = do

  nodes <- zip [1..] . map (listToTuple2 . map (fst . fromJust . BS.readInt) . BS.words) . BS.lines <$> BS.getContents :: IO [(Int,(Int,Int))]

  
  let roads = map (\((n1,d1),(n2,d2)) -> (n1,n2,dist d1 d2)) $ f (sortBy (comparing (fst . snd)) nodes) ++ f (sortBy (comparing (snd . snd)) nodes)

  where

data UnionFind = UnionFind {tree :: M.IntMap Point, rk :: M.IntMap Rank}
type Point = Int
type Rank = Int

rep :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point
rep uf = (M.!) (tree uf)

rank :: UnionFind -> Point -> Rank
rank uf = (M.!) (rk uf)

merge :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point -> UnionFind
merge uf p1 p2
  | r1 /= r2 && rank uf r1 > rank uf r2 = UnionFind (M.insert p2 r1 (M.insert r2 r1 (tree uf))) (M.insert r1 (r1 + r2) (rk uf)) 
  | r1 /= r2 = UnionFind (M.insert p1 r2 (M.insert r1 r2 (tree uf))) (M.insert r2 (r1 + r2) (rk uf)) 
  | otherwise = uf
  where
    r1 = untilFix (rep uf) p1
    r2 = untilFix (rep uf) p2

same :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point -> Bool
same uf p1 p2 = untilFix (rep uf) p1 == untilFix (rep uf) p2

fromDistinctAscList :: [Point] -> UnionFind
fromDistinctAscList ps = UnionFind tree0 rk0
  where
    tree0 = M.fromDistinctAscList [(i,i) | i <- ps]
    rk0 = M.fromDistinctAscList [(i,1) | i <- ps]

import qualified Data.IntSet as S
import Data.Ord
import Prelude hiding (head, tail, null, filter)
import Data.Vector.Unboxed

main = C.interact $ put . sol . get

get = unfoldr (C.readInt . C.dropWhile (<'0'))

put = C.pack . show

sol :: Vector Int -> Int
sol v = prim es
  where
  n = head v
  u = tail v
  vs = generate n (\i -> (u!(2*i),u!(2*i+1)))
  es = fromList [(cost i j,i,j) | i <- [0..n-2], j <- [i+1..n-1]] :: Vector (Int, Int, Int)
  cost i j = min (abs (fst (vs!i) - fst (vs!j))) (abs (snd (vs!i) - snd (vs!j)))

-- Prim's minimum spanning tree 
prim es = f (S.singleton i0) 0
  where
  (_,i0,_) = head es
  f s a = if null r then a else f (S.insert i (S.insert j s)) (c+a)
    where
    r = filter (\(_,i,j) -> S.member i s /= S.member j s) es
    (c,i,j) = minimumBy (comparing cost) r

cost :: (Int, Int, Int) -> Int
cost (c,_,_) = c

import Data.List

kruskal n edge = makepath (map return [0..n-1]) [] edge
 where

  makepath ts acc (((a,b),d):abd)
   | disjoint a b ts = makepath (link a b ts) ((((a,b),d)):acc) abd

    link a b ts = let (ab,ts') = partition (\t -> elem a t || elem b t) ts in concat ab : ts'

merge uf p1 p2
  | i1 && i2 = UnionFind (M.insert p2 p1 (M.insert p1 p1 (tree uf))) (M.insert p1 2 (rk uf))
  | i1 = UnionFind (M.insert p1 rp2 (tree uf)) (M.insert rp2 (rk2 + 1) (rk uf))
  | i2 = UnionFind (M.insert p2 rp1 (tree uf)) (M.insert rp1 (rk1 + 1) (rk uf))
  | rp1 /= rp2 && rk1 > rk2 = UnionFind (M.insert p2 rp1 (M.insert rp2 rp1 (tree uf))) (M.insert rp1 (rk1 + rk2) (rk uf))
  | rp1 /= rp2 = UnionFind (M.insert p1 rp2 (M.insert rp1 rp2 (tree uf))) (M.insert rp2 (rk1 + rk2) (rk uf))

    i2 = isolate uf p2
    rk1 = rank uf rp1
    rk2 = rank uf rp2
    rp1 = rep uf p1
    rp2 = rep uf p2

same uf p1 p2
  | p1 == p2 = True
  | otherwise = not (isolate uf p1) && (rep uf p1 == rep uf p2)

query :: VU.Vector (Int,Int) -> Int
query vs = runST $ do
  uf <- initMUF $ VU.length vs
  acc <- newSTRef (0::Int)
  VU.forM_ (edges vs) $ \(i,j,d) -> do
    merged <- unionUF uf i j
    when merged $ (writeSTRef acc $!) . (d+) =<< readSTRef acc

edges :: VU.Vector (Int,Int) -> VU.Vector (Int,Int,Int)
edges vs = VU.create $ do
  vec <- VU.unsafeThaw $ xedges VU.++ yedges
  radSortBy 4 256 (\k -> let !b = k*8 in \(i,j,d) -> shiftR d b .&. 255) vec
  return vec
  where
    xedges = VU.zipWith (\(i0,x0) (i1,x1) -> (i0,i1,x1-x0)) ixs (VU.tail ixs)
    yedges = VU.zipWith (\(i0,y0) (i1,y1) -> (i0,i1,y1-y0)) iys (VU.tail iys)
    ixs = VU.create $ do
      ixs <- VU.unsafeThaw $ VU.indexed xs
      radSortBy 4 256 (\k -> let !b = k*8 in \(i,x) -> shiftR x b .&. 255) ixs
      return ixs
    iys = VU.create $ do
      iys <- VU.unsafeThaw $ VU.indexed ys
      radSortBy 4 256 (\k -> let !b = k*8 in \(i,y) -> shiftR y b .&. 255) iys
      return iys
    (xs,ys) = VU.unzip vs


type MUFTree s = VUM.MVector s Int
type UFTree = VU.Vector Int

initMUF :: Int -> ST s (MUFTree s)
{-# INLINE initMUF #-}
initMUF len = VUM.replicate len minBound

findUF :: MUFTree s -> Int -> ST s Int
{-# INLINE findUF #-}
findUF vec j = do
  vj <- VUM.read vec j
  if vj < 0 then
    return j
  else do
    root <- findUF vec vj
    VUM.write vec j root
    return root
 
unionUF :: MUFTree s -> Int -> Int -> ST s Bool
{-# INLINE unionUF #-}
unionUF vec i j = do
  rooti <- findUF vec i
  rootj <- findUF vec j
  if rooti == rootj then
    return False
  else do
    ranki <- VUM.read vec rooti
    rankj <- VUM.read vec rootj
    case compare ranki rankj of
      LT ->    VUM.write vec rootj rooti
      GT ->    VUM.write vec rooti rootj
      EQ -> do VUM.write vec rootj rooti
               VUM.write vec rooti (ranki+1)
    return True

radSortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
       => Int               -- ^ the number of passes
       -> Int               -- ^ the size of auxiliary arrays
       -> (Int -> e -> Int) -- ^ the radix function
       -> v (PrimState m) e -- ^ the array to be sorted
       -> m ()
radSortBy passes size rdx arr = do
  tmp    <- VGM.new (VGM.length arr)
  count  <- VPM.new size
  radSort_loop passes rdx arr tmp count
{-# INLINE radSortBy #-}



radSort_loop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
          => Int                          -- passes
          -> (Int -> e -> Int)            -- radix function
          -> v (PrimState m) e            -- array to sort
          -> v (PrimState m) e            -- temporary array
          -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -- radix count array
          -> m ()
radSort_loop passes rdx src dst count = go False 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go swap k
   | k < passes = if swap
                    then radSort_body (rdx k) dst src count >> go False (k+1)
                    else radSort_body (rdx k) src dst count >> go True  (k+1)
   | otherwise  = when swap (VGM.unsafeCopy src dst)
{-# INLINE radSort_loop #-}


radSort_body :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
     => (e -> Int)                   -- radix function
     -> v (PrimState m) e            -- source array
     -> v (PrimState m) e            -- destination array
     -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -- radix count
     -> m ()
radSort_body rdx src dst count = do
  radSort_countLoop rdx src count
  radSort_accum count
  radSort_moveLoop rdx src dst count
{-# INLINE radSort_body #-}

radSort_accum :: (PrimMonad m)
           => VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
radSort_accum count = go 0 0
 where
 len = VPM.length count
 go i !acc
   | i < len   = do ci <- VPM.unsafeRead count i
                    VPM.unsafeWrite count i acc
                    go (i+1) (acc + ci)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE radSort_accum #-}

radSort_moveLoop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
         => (e -> Int) -> v (PrimState m) e
         -> v (PrimState m) e -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
radSort_moveLoop rdx src dst prefix = go 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go i
   | i < len    = do srci <- VGM.unsafeRead src i
                     pf   <- vec_inc prefix (rdx srci)
                     VGM.unsafeWrite dst pf srci
                     go (i+1)
   | otherwise  = return ()
{-# INLINE radSort_moveLoop #-}


radSort_countLoop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
          => (e -> Int)
          -> v (PrimState m) e -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
radSort_countLoop rdx src count = VPM.set count 0 >> go 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go i
   | i < len    = VGM.unsafeRead src i >>= vec_inc count . rdx >> go (i+1)
   | otherwise  = return ()
{-# INLINE radSort_countLoop #-}


vec_inc :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v Int) => v (PrimState m) Int
        -> Int -> m Int
vec_inc arr i = VGM.unsafeRead arr i
  >>= \e -> VGM.unsafeWrite arr i (e+1) >> return e
{-# INLINE vec_inc #-}

      edge = sortBy compEdge $ (makeEdge sortedX) ++ (makeEdge sortedY)

bsToInt :: BC.ByteString -> Int
bsToInt = fst . fromJust . BC.readInt

getInt2DListBC :: IO [[Int]]
getInt2DListBC = map (map bsToInt . BC.words) . BC.lines <$> BC.getContents

makeEdge :: [(Int, Int)] -> [(Int, Int, Int)]
makeEdge (_:[]) = []
makeEdge (x:y:ys) = (fst x, fst y, abs $ (snd x) - (snd y)) : makeEdge (y:ys)

compEdge :: (Int, Int, Int) -> (Int, Int, Int) -> Ordering
compEdge (_, _, x) (_, _, y) = compare x y

greedy :: IOUArray Int Int -> [(Int, Int, Int)] -> Int -> Int -> IO Int
greedy parent ((i, j, w):es) n k
  | n == k    = return 0
  | otherwise = do
    pI <- getParent parent i
    pJ <- getParent parent j
    if pI == pJ then greedy parent es n k
                else do
                  writeArray parent pI pJ
                  sum <- greedy parent es n $ k + 1
                  return $ w + sum
getParent :: IOUArray Int Int -> Int -> IO Int
getParent memo i = do
  parent <- readArray memo i
  case parent of
    0 -> return i
    _ -> getParent memo parent

      pointY = zip [1..n] y
      sortedX = sortBy (\x y -> compare (snd x) (snd y)) pointX
      sortedY = sortBy (\x y -> compare (snd x) (snd y)) pointY
      edge = sortBy compEdge $ (makeEdge sortedX) ++ (makeEdge sortedY)
  print =<< greedy parent edge (n-1) 0

makeEdge :: [(Int, Int)] -> [(Int, Int, Int)]
makeEdge (_:[]) = []
makeEdge (x:y:ys) = (fst x, fst y, abs $ (snd x) - (snd y)) : makeEdge (y:ys)

compEdge :: (Int, Int, Int) -> (Int, Int, Int) -> Ordering
compEdge (_, _, x) (_, _, y) = compare x y

greedy :: IOUArray Int Int -> [(Int, Int, Int)] -> Int -> Int -> IO Int
greedy parent ((i, j, w):es) n k
  | n == k    = return 0
  | otherwise = do
    pI <- getParent parent i
    pJ <- getParent parent j
    if pI == pJ then greedy parent es n k
                else do
                  writeArray parent pI pJ
                  sum <- greedy parent es n $ k + 1
                  return $ w + sum

getParent :: IOUArray Int Int -> Int -> IO Int
getParent memo i = do
  parent <- readArray memo i
  case parent of
    0 -> return i
    _ -> do
      pp <- getParent memo parent
      writeArray memo i pp
      return pp

data UnionFind = UnionFind {tree :: M.IntMap Point, rk :: M.IntMap Rank}
type Point = Int
type Rank = Int

rep :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point
rep uf = (M.!) (tree uf)

rank :: UnionFind -> Point -> Rank
rank uf = (M.!) (rk uf)

merge :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point -> UnionFind
merge uf p1 p2
  | r1 /= r2 && rank uf r1 > rank uf r2 = UnionFind (M.insert p2 r1 (M.insert r2 r1 (tree uf))) (M.insert r1 (r1 + r2) (rk uf)) 
  | r1 /= r2 = UnionFind (M.insert p1 r2 (M.insert r1 r2 (tree uf))) (M.insert r2 (r1 + r2) (rk uf)) 
  | otherwise = uf
  where
    r1 = untilFix (rep uf) p1
    r2 = untilFix (rep uf) p2

same :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point -> Bool
same uf p1 p2 = untilFix (rep uf) p1 == untilFix (rep uf) p2

fromDistinctAscList :: [Point] -> UnionFind
fromDistinctAscList ps = UnionFind tree0 rk0
  where
    tree0 = M.fromDistinctAscList [(i,i) | i <- ps]
    rk0 = M.fromDistinctAscList [(i,1) | i <- ps]

findUFIO :: Int -> UnionFindIO -> IO Int

    else do

    writeArray uf x next
    return next

sameUFIO :: Int -> Int -> UnionFindIO -> IO Bool
sameUFIO x y uf = do
  xx <- findUFIO x uf
  yy <- findUFIO y uf
  return $ xx == yy

unionUFIO :: Int -> Int -> UnionFindIO -> IO ()
unionUFIO x y uf = do
  xx <- findUFIO x uf
  yy <- findUFIO y uf

  if xx == yy then
    return ()
    else
    writeArray uf x y

    kruskal' [] = return []
    kruskal' (e@((i,(xi,yi)),(j,(xj,yj))):es) = do
      same <- sameUFIO i j uf
      if same then
        kruskal' es
        else do

query :: Int -> BSL.ByteString -> Int
query n bs = runST $ do
  uf <- initMUF n
  VU.foldr
    (\(i,j,d) cont !acc -> do
        merged <- unionUF uf i j
        if merged then cont (acc+d) else cont acc)
    (return $!)
    (edges n bs)
    0

edges :: Int -> BSL.ByteString -> VU.Vector (Int,Int,Int)
edges n !bs = VU.create $ do
  ixys <- VUM.unsafeNew $ n `shiftL` 1
  foldr (\ !i cont !input0 -> do
    let Just (!xi, !input1) = BSL.readInt $ BSL.dropWhile (<'!') input0
        Just (!yi, !input2) = BSL.readInt $ BSL.dropWhile (<'!') input1
    VUM.unsafeWrite ixys    i  (i,xi)
    VUM.unsafeWrite ixys (n+i) (i,yi)
    cont input2)
    (\ !input -> return ())
    [0..n-1] bs
  rad_count <- VPM.unsafeNew 256
  rad_tmp0 <- VUM.unsafeNew $ n `shiftL` 1 - 1
  rad_tmp1 <- VUM.unsafeNew $ n `shiftL` 1 - 1
  rad_tmp2 <- VUM.unsafeNew $ n `shiftL` 1 - 1
  let rad_tmpA = VUM.unsafeTake n $ VUM.zip rad_tmp0 rad_tmp1
      rad_tmpB = VUM.zip3 rad_tmp0 rad_tmp1 rad_tmp2
  radSort_loop 4 (\k -> let !b = k*8 in \(i,x) -> shiftR x b .&. 255)
    (VUM.unsafeTake n ixys) rad_tmpA rad_count
  radSort_loop 4 (\k -> let !b = k*8 in \(i,y) -> shiftR y b .&. 255)
    (VUM.unsafeDrop n ixys) rad_tmpA rad_count
  let (is, xys) = VUM.unzip ixys
  forM_ [0..2*n-2] $ \i -> do
    v_ip1 <- VUM.unsafeRead xys $ i+1
    VUM.unsafeModify xys (v_ip1-) i
  VUM.unsafeWrite xys (n-1) (2^32-1)
  js <- VUM.clone $ VUM.tail is
  let ijds = VUM.zip3 is js xys
  radSort_loop 4 (\k -> let !b = k*8 in \(i,j,d) -> shiftR d b .&. 255)
    ijds rad_tmpB rad_count
  return ijds


type MUFTree s = VUM.MVector s Int
type UFTree = VU.Vector Int

initMUF :: Int -> ST s (MUFTree s)
{-# INLINE initMUF #-}
initMUF len = VUM.replicate len minBound

findUF :: MUFTree s -> Int -> ST s Int
{-# INLINE findUF #-}
findUF vec j = do
  vj <- VUM.read vec j
  if vj < 0 then
    return j
  else do
    root <- findUF vec vj
    VUM.write vec j root
    return root
 
unionUF :: MUFTree s -> Int -> Int -> ST s Bool
{-# INLINE unionUF #-}
unionUF vec i j = do
  rooti <- findUF vec i
  rootj <- findUF vec j
  if rooti == rootj then
    return False
  else do
    ranki <- VUM.read vec rooti
    rankj <- VUM.read vec rootj
    case compare ranki rankj of
      LT ->    VUM.write vec rootj rooti
      GT ->    VUM.write vec rooti rootj
      EQ -> do VUM.write vec rootj rooti
               VUM.write vec rooti (ranki+1)
    return True

radSortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
       => Int               -- ^ the number of passes
       -> Int               -- ^ the size of auxiliary arrays
       -> (Int -> e -> Int) -- ^ the radix function
       -> v (PrimState m) e -- ^ the array to be sorted
       -> m ()
radSortBy passes size rdx arr = do
  tmp    <- VGM.new (VGM.length arr)
  count  <- VPM.new size
  radSort_loop passes rdx arr tmp count
{-# INLINE radSortBy #-}



radSort_loop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
          => Int                          -- passes
          -> (Int -> e -> Int)            -- radix function
          -> v (PrimState m) e            -- array to sort
          -> v (PrimState m) e            -- temporary array
          -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -- radix count array
          -> m ()
radSort_loop passes rdx src dst count = go False 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go swap k
   | k < passes = if swap
                    then radSort_body (rdx k) dst src count >> go False (k+1)
                    else radSort_body (rdx k) src dst count >> go True  (k+1)
   | otherwise  = when swap (VGM.unsafeCopy src dst)
{-# INLINE radSort_loop #-}


radSort_body :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
     => (e -> Int)                   -- radix function
     -> v (PrimState m) e            -- source array
     -> v (PrimState m) e            -- destination array
     -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -- radix count
     -> m ()
radSort_body rdx src dst count = do
  radSort_countLoop rdx src count
  radSort_accum count
  radSort_moveLoop rdx src dst count
{-# INLINE radSort_body #-}

radSort_accum :: (PrimMonad m)
           => VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
radSort_accum count = go 0 0
 where
 len = VPM.length count
 go i !acc
   | i < len   = do ci <- VPM.unsafeRead count i
                    VPM.unsafeWrite count i acc
                    go (i+1) (acc + ci)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE radSort_accum #-}

radSort_moveLoop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
         => (e -> Int) -> v (PrimState m) e
         -> v (PrimState m) e -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
radSort_moveLoop rdx src dst prefix = go 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go i
   | i < len    = do srci <- VGM.unsafeRead src i
                     pf   <- vec_inc prefix (rdx srci)
                     VGM.unsafeWrite dst pf srci
                     go (i+1)
   | otherwise  = return ()
{-# INLINE radSort_moveLoop #-}


radSort_countLoop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
          => (e -> Int)
          -> v (PrimState m) e -> VPM.MVector (PrimState m) Int -> m ()
radSort_countLoop rdx src count = VPM.set count 0 >> go 0
 where
 len = VGM.length src
 go i
   | i < len    = VGM.unsafeRead src i >>= vec_inc count . rdx >> go (i+1)
   | otherwise  = return ()
{-# INLINE radSort_countLoop #-}


vec_inc :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v Int) => v (PrimState m) Int
        -> Int -> m Int
vec_inc arr i = VGM.unsafeRead arr i
  >>= \e -> VGM.unsafeWrite arr i (e+1) >> return e
{-# INLINE vec_inc #-}

  tree :: M.IntMap Point,
  rk :: M.IntMap Rank
} deriving (Eq, Show)

type Point = Int -- greater than 0

initial :: UnionFind
initial = UnionFind M.empty M.empty

rep :: UnionFind -> Point -> Point
rep uf p
  | M.notMember p (tree uf) = p
  | tree uf M.! p == p = p
  | otherwise = rep uf (tree uf M.! p)

merge uf p q
  | p2 == q2 = uf
  | otherwise = UnionFind (M.insert rp2 rp1 (M.insert o2 rp1 (tree uf))) (M.insert rp1 (rk1 + rk2) (rk uf))
  where
    [(rk1,rp1,o1),(rk2,rp2,o2)] = map (\(a,b,c) -> (a,(-b),c) ) $ sort [(p1,(-p2),p3),(q1,(-q2),q3)]
    (p1,p2,p3) = (rank uf p, rep uf p, p)
    (q1,q2,q3) = (rank uf q, rep uf q, q)

type UnionFindIO = IOArray Int (Int,Int)

newUFIO :: Int -> IO UnionFindIO
newUFIO n = newListArray (1,n) (zip [1..n] (repeat 1))

findUFIO :: Int -> UnionFindIO -> IO Int
findUFIO x uf = do
  (parent,size) <- readArray uf x
  if parent == x then
    return x
    else do
    next <- findUFIO parent uf
    writeArray uf x (next,size)
    return next

sameUFIO :: Int -> Int -> UnionFindIO -> IO Bool
sameUFIO x y uf = do
  xx <- findUFIO x uf
  yy <- findUFIO y uf
  return $ xx == yy

uniteUFIO :: Int -> Int -> UnionFindIO -> IO ()
uniteUFIO x y uf = do
  xx <- findUFIO x uf
  yy <- findUFIO y uf
  (_,xs) <- readArray uf xx
  (_,ys) <- readArray uf yy

  if xx == yy then
    return ()
    else if xs < ys then do
    writeArray uf xx (yy,0)
    else if xs > ys then do
    writeArray uf yy (xx,0)
    else do
    writeArray uf yy (xx,0)
    writeArray uf xx (xx,xs+1)

kruskal :: [City] -> [(City,City)] -> IO Int
kruskal nodes edges = do
  let sorted = sortBy comp (map (\((i,ci),(j,cj)) -> (i,j,dist ci cj)) edges)

  uf <- newUFIO (length nodes)

  let
    kruskal' e@(i,j,c) = do
      same <- sameUFIO i j uf
      if same then
        return 0
        else do
        uniteUFIO i j uf
        return c
        
  mapM kruskal' sorted >>= return . sum
  where
    comp (_,_,c1) (_,_,c2) = compare c1 c2
    dist (x1,y1) (x2,y2) = min (abs $ x1-x2) (abs $ y1-y2)

	if u==parent[u]
		u
	else
		parent[u]=find(parent[u],parent)
	end

function unite(u,v,parent,size)
	u=find(u,parent)
	v=find(v,parent)
	if u!=v
		if size[u]>size[v]
			parent[v]=u
			size[u]+=size[v]
		else
			parent[u]=v
			size[v]+=size[u]
		end
		true
	else
		false
	end
end

class UnionFind
  def initialize(size)
    @rank = Array.new(size, 0)
    @parent = Array.new(size, &:itself)
  end

  def unite(id_x, id_y)
    x_parent = get_parent(id_x)
    y_parent = get_parent(id_y)
    return if x_parent == y_parent

    if @rank[x_parent] > @rank[y_parent]
      @parent[y_parent] = x_parent
    else
      @parent[x_parent] = y_parent
      @rank[y_parent] += 1 if @rank[x_parent] == @rank[y_parent]
    end
  end

  def get_parent(id_x)
    @parent[id_x] == id_x ? id_x : (@parent[id_x] = get_parent(@parent[id_x]))
  end

  def same_parent?(id_x, id_y)
    get_parent(id_x) == get_parent(id_y)
  end
end

class UnionFindTree
  def initialize(n)
    @nodes = (0..n).map { |i| Node.new(i) }
  end
  
  def unite(a, b)
    pa = find(a)
    pb = find(b)
    return if pa == pb
    
    if @nodes[pa].rank < @nodes[pb].rank
      @nodes[pa].parent = pb
    else
      @nodes[pb].parent = pa
      @nodes[pa].rank += 1 if @nodes[pa].rank == @nodes[pb].rank
    end
  end
  
  def same?(a, b)
    find(a) == find(b)
  end
  
  def find(a)
    return a if @nodes[a].parent == a
    @nodes[a].parent = find(@nodes[a].parent)
  end
  
  private 
  
  class Node
    attr_accessor :parent, :rank
    
    def initialize(n)
      @parent = n
      @rank = 0
    end
  end
end

    @nodes = Array.new(n){ Node.new }
    @nodes.map.with_index do |node,idx|
      node.u = idx
      node
    end

               true
             else
               false
             end
    result
  end

  def gen_uniq_edges()
    edges = []
    @nodes.each_with_index do |node,i|
      mat[i].map.with_index.select do |w,idx|
        w != -1
      end.each do |w,idx|
        edge = [node.u, idx].sort
        edges << edge
      end
    end
    edges.uniq
  end

  def prim(start = 0)
    @nodes = @nodes.each do |node|
      node.d = INF
      node.p = nil
      node.c = :white
    end
    @nodes[start].d = 0
    @nodes[start].p = -1
    next_u = nil

    while true
      mincost = INF

      @nodes.each do |node|
        if node.c != :black and node.d < mincost
          mincost = node.d
          next_u  = node.u
        end
      end
      #puts "mincost = #{mincost}, next_u = #{next_u}"

      break if mincost == INF

      @nodes[next_u.to_i].c = :black

      @nodes = @nodes.map.with_index do |node, v|
        if node.c != :black and edge_exists?(next_u, v) and mat[next_u-1][v-1] < node.d
          node.d = mat[next_u][v]
          node.p = next_u
          node.c = :gray
          #puts "  update: node(#{node.u}), d = #{node.d}, parent = #{next_u}"
          node
        else
          node
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

class PriorityQueue
  attr_reader :size

  def initialize(order: :asc)
    @size = 0
    @nodes = []
    @operator = (order == :asc) ? [:>, :<] : [:<, :>]
  end

  def empty?
    @size.zero?
  end

  def push(node)
    if @nodes[0].nil?
      @nodes[0] = node
    else
      index = size
      @nodes[index] = node

      loop {
        parent = (index-1)/2

        if (@nodes[parent].last <=> node.last).public_send(@operator.first, 0)
          @nodes[index], @nodes[parent] = @nodes[parent], @nodes[index]
          index = parent

          break if index.zero?
        else
          break
        end
      }
    end

    @size += 1
  end

  alias_method :<<, :push

  def pop
    node = @nodes.first
    @nodes[0], @nodes[size - 1] = @nodes[size - 1], nil
    index = 0

    loop {
      left = 2*index+1
      right = 2*index+2

      if @nodes[left].nil? && @nodes[right].nil?
        break
      elsif @nodes[left] && @nodes[right]
        target = (@nodes[left].last <=> @nodes[right].last).public_send(@operator.last, 0) ? left : right

        if (@nodes[target].last <=> @nodes[index].last).public_send(@operator.last, 0)
          @nodes[index], @nodes[target] = @nodes[target], @nodes[index]
          index = target
        else
          break
        end
      elsif @nodes[left]
        if (@nodes[left].last <=> @nodes[index].last).public_send(@operator.last, 0)
          @nodes[index], @nodes[left] = @nodes[left], @nodes[index]
          index = left
        else
          break
        end
      elsif @nodes[right]
        if (@nodes[right].last <=> @nodes[index].last).public_send(@operator.last, 0)
          @nodes[index], @nodes[right] = @nodes[right], @nodes[index]
          index = right
        else
          break
        end
      end
    }

    @size -= 1
    node.first
  end

  def top
    @nodes.first
  end
end

    (@node[x]=find_set(@node[x])) unless @node[x]==x
    @node[x]
  end
  def union(x,y)#: 指定された２つの要素を合併する
    link(find_set(x),find_set(y))
  end

    return false if x==y

    @node[b]=a
  end
  def same?(a,b)
    find_set(a)==find_set(b)
  end
end

class UnionFind
  attr_reader :rank, :parent, :value
  attr_writer :rank, :parent

  def initialize(x)
    @value = x
    @rank = 0
    @parent = self
  end

  def ==(obj)
    @value == obj.value
  end

  def find
    return self if self.parent == self
    root = self.parent.find
    self.parent = root
    root
  end

  def union(y)
    xr = find; yr = y.find
    return if xr == yr
    if xr.rank >= yr.rank
      yr.parent = xr
      xr.rank += 1
    else
      y.union(self)
    end
  end
end

def minimum_spanning_tree_kruskal(nodes, edges)
  # edges: [[node_from, node_to, weight]]
  edges.sort_by!{ |e| e[2] }
  th = Hash[nodes.map{ |x| [x, UnionFind.new(x)] }]
  i = 0
  mst = []
  while i < edges.size
    e = edges[i]
    i += 1
    f,t,w = *e
    tf = th[f]; tt = th[t]
    next if (tf.find == tt.find)
    tf.union(tt)
    mst << e
  end
  mst
end

class PriorityQueue
  MIN = -(1 << 60)

  attr_reader :size

  def initialize(capacity = nil, &block)
    @size = 0
    @heap = if capacity.nil?
      Array.new
    else
      # capacity には、queue のサイズとしてありえる最大の数を指定する想定。
      # @heap[1] から使用するため、配列サイズを 1つ余分に確保する。
      Array.new(capacity + 1)
    end
    @get_key = block || :itself.to_proc
  end

  def empty?
    size == 0
  end

  def pop
    return nil if @size <= 0
    max = @heap[1]
    @heap[1] = @heap[@size]
    @size -= 1
    max_heapify(1)
    max
  end

  def push(x)
    @size += 1
    i = @size
    @heap[i] = x
    while i > 1 && (@get_key.call(@heap[i / 2]) <=> @get_key.call(@heap[i])) < 0
      t = @heap[i / 2]
      @heap[i / 2] = @heap[i]
      @heap[i] = t
      i = i / 2
    end
  end

  def top
    return nil if @size <= 0
    @heap[1]
  end

  def to_a
    return [] if @size == 0
    @heap[1..@size]
  end

  private

  def max_heapify(i)
    l = 2 * i
    r = 2 * i + 1
    largest =
      l <= @size && (@get_key.call(@heap[l]) <=> @get_key.call(@heap[i])) > 0 ? l : i
    largest = r \
      if r <= @size && (@get_key.call(@heap[r]) <=> @get_key.call(@heap[largest])) > 0
    unless largest == i
      t = @heap[i]
      @heap[i] = @heap[largest]
      @heap[largest] = t
      max_heapify(largest)
    end
  end
end

def prim(graph, s)
  require 'set'
  used = Set.new
  queue = PriorityQueue.new do |_, c|
    -c
  end
  queue.push([s, 0])
  ret = 0
  while !queue.empty?
    u, w = queue.pop
    next if used.include?(u)
    used.add(u)
    ret += w
    graph[u].each do |v, c|
      next if used.include?(v)
      queue.push([v, c])
    end
  end
  ret
end

  class ParArray < Hash
    def [] key
      self[key] = key if super(key).nil?
      super(key)
    end
  end

  class SizeArray < Hash
    def [] key
      self[key] = 1 if super(key).nil?
      super(key)
    end
  end

  def initialize()
    @par = ParArray.new
    @size = SizeArray.new
  end

  private

  def find(x)
    return x if x == @par[x]
    return @par[x] = find(@par[x])
  end

  public

  def unite(x, y)
    x = find(x)
    y = find(y)

    return nil if x == y
    x, y = y, x if @size[x] < @size[y]

    @par[y] = x
    @size[x] += @size[y]
  end

  def same?(x, y)
    return find(x) == find(y)
  end

  def size(x)
    return @size[find(x)]
  end

end

class PriorityQueue
  attr_reader :elements
  
  def initialize(e=[])
    @elements = e
  end
  
  def push(n)
    i = @elements.size
    while i > 0
      p = (i-1) / 2
      break if @elements[p].cost <= n.cost
      @elements[i] = @elements[p]
      i = p
    end
    @elements[i] = n
  end
  alias :<< :push
  
  def pop
    min = @elements[0]
    n   = @elements.pop
    unless @elements.empty?
      i = 0
      while i * 2 + 1 < @elements.size
        if @elements[i * 2 + 2].nil? or @elements[i * 2 + 1].cost < @elements[i * 2 + 2].cost
          buf = i * 2 + 1
        else
          buf = i * 2 + 2
        end
        break if @elements[buf].cost >= n.cost
        @elements[i] = @elements[buf]
        i = buf
      end
      @elements[i] = n
    end
    min
  end
  
  def empty?
    @elements.empty?
  end
end

class UnionFind
  # @param {Integer} n
  def initialize(n)
    @id = Array.new(n)
    @sz = Array.new(n)
    n.times do |i|
      @id[i] = i
      @sz[i] = 1
    end
  end
 
  def connected?(i, j)
    root(i) == root(j)
  end
 
  def unite(i, j)
    iroot = root(i)
    jroot = root(j)
    return if iroot == jroot
    if @sz[iroot] < @sz[jroot]
      @id[iroot] = j
      @sz[jroot] += @sz[iroot]
    else
      @id[jroot] = i
      @sz[iroot] += @sz[jroot]
    end
  end
 
  private
 
  def root(i)
    if @id[i] == i
      i
    else
      @id[i] = @id[@id[i]] # pass compression
      root(@id[i])
    end
  end
end

def kruskal(n, edges)
    edges = edges.sort_by{|edge| edge[2]}
    uf = UnionFind.new(n)
    res = 0
    edges.each do |edge|
        u = edge[0]
        v = edge[1]
        unless uf.same?(u, v)
            uf.unite(u, v)
            res += edge[2]
        end
    end
    return res
end

    end

      @parent[c] = x
    end

    x
  end

    y = find(y)

    @size[x] += @size[y]

  end

    x_parent = get_parent(id_x)

      @parent[y_parent] = x_parent

    end
  end

    @parent[id_x] == id_x ? id_x : (@parent[id_x] = get_parent(@parent[id_x]))
  end

  def same_parent?(id_x, id_y)
    get_parent(id_x) == get_parent(id_y)
  end
end

class PriorityQueue
  attr_reader :elements
  
  def initialize(e=[])
    @elements = e
  end
  
  def push(n)
    i = @elements.size
    while i > 0
      p = (i-1) / 2
      break if @elements[p].cost <= n.cost
      @elements[i] = @elements[p]
      i = p
    end
    @elements[i] = n
  end
  alias :<< :push
  
  def pop
    min = @elements[0]
    n   = @elements.pop
    unless @elements.empty?
      i = 0
      while i * 2 + 1 < @elements.size
        if @elements[i * 2 + 2].nil? or @elements[i * 2 + 1].cost < @elements[i * 2 + 2].cost
          buf = i * 2 + 1
        else
          buf = i * 2 + 2
        end
        break if @elements[buf].cost >= n.cost
        @elements[i] = @elements[buf]
        i = buf
      end
      @elements[i] = n
    end
    min
  end
  
  def empty?
    @elements.empty?
  end
end

class UnionFindTree
  def initialize(n)
    @nodes = (0..n).map { |i| Node.new(i) }
  end
  
  def unite(a, b)
    pa = find(a)
    pb = find(b)
    return if pa == pb
    
    if @nodes[pa].rank < @nodes[pb].rank
      @nodes[pa].parent = pb
    else
      @nodes[pb].parent = pa
      @nodes[pa].rank += 1 if @nodes[pa].rank == @nodes[pb].rank
    end
  end
  
  def same?(a, b)
    find(a) == find(b)
  end
  
  def find(a)
    return a if @nodes[a].parent == a
    @nodes[a].parent = find(@nodes[a].parent)
  end
  
  def parents
    @nodes.map(&:parent)
  end
  
  private 
  
  class Node
    attr_accessor :parent, :rank
    
    def initialize(n)
      @parent = n
      @rank = 0
    end
  end
end

      -@priority <=> -other.priority

    @elements.size

    last_element_index = @elements.size - 1
    @elements.sort!
    @elements.delete_at(last_element_index)
  end

class UnionFind
  def initialize size
    @parents = []
    size.times do |i|
      @parents[i] = i
    end
    @sizes = [1] * size
  end

  def find a
    a == @parents[a] ? a : find(@parents[a])
  end

  def union a, b
    ra = find a
    rb = find b
    return if ra == rb

    if @sizes[ra] > @sizes[rb]
      @parents[rb] = @parents[ra]
      @sizes[ra] += @sizes[rb]
    else
      @parents[ra] = @parents[rb]
      @sizes[rb] += @sizes[ra]
    end
  end
end

class UnionFind
  def initialize(size)
    @rank = Array.new(size, 0)
    @parent = Array.new(size, &:itself)
  end

  def unite(id_x, id_y)
    x_parent = get_parent(id_x)
    y_parent = get_parent(id_y)
    return if x_parent == y_parent

    if @rank[x_parent] > @rank[y_parent]
      @parent[y_parent] = x_parent
    else
      @parent[x_parent] = y_parent
      @rank[y_parent] += 1 if @rank[x_parent] == @rank[y_parent]
    end
  end

  def get_parent(id_x)
    @parent[id_x] == id_x ? id_x : (@parent[id_x] = get_parent(@parent[id_x]))
  end

  def same_parent?(id_x, id_y)
    get_parent(id_x) == get_parent(id_y)
  end
end

  end

    a = root(a)
    b = root(b)

    @parents[a] += @parents[b] # if negative value means size
    @parents[b] = a
    true

    @parents[a] < 0 ? a : (@parents[a] = root(@parents[a]))
  end

  end

    -@parents[root(a)]
  end

class PriorityQueue
  attr_reader :elements
  
  def initialize(e=[])
    @elements = e
  end
  
  def push(n)
    i = @elements.size
    while i > 0
      p = (i-1) / 2
      break if @elements[p].cost <= n.cost
      @elements[i] = @elements[p]
      i = p
    end
    @elements[i] = n
  end
  alias :<< :push
  
  def pop
    min = @elements[0]
    n   = @elements.pop
    unless @elements.empty?
      i = 0
      while i * 2 + 1 < @elements.size
        if @elements[i * 2 + 2].nil? or @elements[i * 2 + 1].cost < @elements[i * 2 + 2].cost
          buf = i * 2 + 1
        else
          buf = i * 2 + 2
        end
        break if @elements[buf].cost >= n.cost
        @elements[i] = @elements[buf]
        i = buf
      end
      @elements[i] = n
    end
    min
  end
  
  def empty?
    @elements.empty?
  end
end

  end

    @nodes[a].parent = find(@nodes[a].parent)
  end
  
  private

      @parent = n
      @rank = 0
    end
  end
end

class PriorityQueue
  attr_reader :size

  def initialize(order: :asc)
    @size = 0
    @nodes = []
    @operator = (order == :asc) ? [:>, :<] : [:<, :>]
  end

  def empty?
    @size.zero?
  end

  def push(node)
    if @nodes[0].nil?
      @nodes[0] = node
    else
      index = size
      @nodes[index] = node

      loop {
        parent = (index-1)/2

        if (@nodes[parent].last <=> node.last).public_send(@operator.first, 0)
          @nodes[index], @nodes[parent] = @nodes[parent], @nodes[index]
          index = parent

          break if index.zero?
        else
          break
        end
      }
    end

    @size += 1
  end

  alias_method :<<, :push

  def pop
    node = @nodes.first
    @nodes[0], @nodes[size - 1] = @nodes[size - 1], nil
    index = 0

    loop {
      left = 2*index+1
      right = 2*index+2

      if @nodes[left].nil? && @nodes[right].nil?
        break
      elsif @nodes[right].nil? && @nodes[left]
        if (@nodes[left].last <=> @nodes[index].last).public_send(@operator.last, 0)
          @nodes[index], @nodes[left] = @nodes[left], @nodes[index]
          index = left
        else
          break
        end
      elsif @nodes[left].nil? && @nodes[right]
        if (@nodes[right].last <=> @nodes[index].last).public_send(@operator.last, 0)
          @nodes[index], @nodes[right] = @nodes[right], @nodes[index]
          index = right
        else
          break
        end
      elsif (@nodes[left].last <=> @nodes[right].last).public_send(@operator.last, 0)
        @nodes[index], @nodes[left] = @nodes[left], @nodes[index]
        index = left
      else
        @nodes[index], @nodes[right] = @nodes[right], @nodes[index]
        index = right
      end
    }

    @size -= 1
    node.first
  end

  def top
    @nodes.first
  end
end
